faq: Will you copy text from suppliers?
No. Supplier text appears on many stores, which makes pages look duplicate to search engines. We write original text from your product details and the search terms customers use.
Do I need keyword research first?
It helps, but is not required. If you have no keyword list, we choose terms for each page as part of the work, and show you which ones we picked.
Can you apply the changes for me?
Yes. We add the new titles, descriptions and text directly in your store as staff. You receive a sheet showing the old and new versions.
What about products I add later?
We include a short style guide at the Premium level, so you or your team can write new product pages in the same way.
